title: Buddy Petit, Louis Armstrong and the Florida and Alabama trip
summary: Eddie recalls Buddy Petit, close to Louis Armstrong, and a trip to Florida, then Montgomery, and an invitation to play block dances in Los Angeles around 1921 that he declined.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: That's right. I was regularly in 27, 26, all that fun. And then on 19, 19, unless it was Buddy Petit. Did you ever tell you about him? He was one of the great corner of the head around him.
Him and Louis Armstrong used to be like that. They were like brothers. Louis Armstrong, Buddy Petit. Went to Paschipola Florida.

So we stood over there for a year and left there and went to Montgomery, Alabama. And then a kid over sent for us in 21 in Los Angeles to play block dances. So Louis said he was going home. He wasn't going to California. So I'll come home with no one. So I'll do the work out for us. Uh-huh. I'll come back. I got married. So music got away from me. He didn't get away from that.
But things were tough. Yeah. Couldn't get paid. That's it.
